summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc., a Vancouver-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, together with CEO and CFO interim certifications. No transactional event is disclosed: no acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, or management change. Figures show nine-month revenue of $25.2 million, an operating loss of $7.4 million, cash of $12.5 million versus $23.0 million at year-end 2025, and loans of $2.7 million current. This is a routine periodic reporting filing; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
